Welcome to the Jungle Film Earns Over ₹100 Crore in Opening Days

The film 'Welcome to the Jungle,' starring Akshay Kumar, has crossed the ₹100 crore mark in its box office collection within its first four days. While the film saw strong performance over the weekend, reports indicate a significant drop in earnings on Monday. The movie's performance is being compared to other releases like 'Supergirl' and 'Cocktail 2'.
